value.rationale: This is a complete, quantitative trace-ideal endpoint for the fundamental Rhaly/terraced operator with a natural monotone-modulus constraint. It detects an extra harmonic logarithm absent from all q>1 Schatten/Besov tests and sharply distinguishes the r>2 trace boundary from r>1/q. The endpoint arises from structural singular-value growth and provides a functional classification rather than an isolated finite calculation.
